issues.detail: Preparation of known 6 is cited to earlier literature, not reproduced; commercial-start completeness is false.
Synthesis discussion reports 93/95% ee; biological-assay discussion refers to 81/83% ee samples. These are not conflated.
issues.subject: 1a/1b

issues.detail: SI procedure gives Oxone 23.6 equivalents; main optimized table reports 4.8 equivalents. No consensus value is invented.
issues.subject: F02

issues.detail: SI section 3.11 prose calls its starting material 16; adjacent scheme and prior preparation identify 3/3a/3b. Scheme-supported connectivity is retained.
issues.subject: F13/F19/F25

issues.detail: Canonical SMILES omits the tetrahedral assignment for explicit racemates; canonical CXSMILES AND groups retain racemic semantics. Chiral a/b records describe the major enantiomer, not 100% ee material.
issues.subject: racemic series

issues.detail: Source-checked transcription with formula checks; independent chemist review remains pending.

Full article coverage means its successful displayed network, not a commercial-start total synthesis. Canonical isomeric SMILES; independent chemical review pending.
